ESV.1: Then he said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.
ESV.2: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but the others shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with him.”
ESV.3: Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD and all the rules.  And all the people answered with one voice and said, “All the words that the LORD has spoken we will do.”
ESV.4: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. He rose early in the morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
ESV.5: And he sent young men of the people of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.
ESV.6: And Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he threw against the altar.
ESV.7: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it in the hearing of the people. And they said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
ESV.8: And Moses took the blood and threw it on the people and said, “Behold the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
ESV.9: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,
ESV.10: and they saw the God of Israel. There was under his feet as it were a pavement of sapphire stone, like the very heaven for clearness.
ESV.11: And he did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; they beheld God, and ate and drank.
ESV.12: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain and wait there, that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction.”
ESV.13: So Moses rose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God.
ESV.14: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever has a dispute, let him go to them.”
ESV.15: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
ESV.16: The glory of the LORD dwelt on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
ESV.17: Now the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the sight of the people of Israel.
ESV.18: Moses entered the cloud and went up on the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

NKJV.1: Now He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.
NKJV.2: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD, but they shall not come near; nor shall the people go up with him.”
NKJV.3: So Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD and all the judgments. And all the people answered with one voice and said, “All the words which the LORD has said we will do.”
NKJV.4: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD. And he rose early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
NKJV.5: Then he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.
NKJV.6: And Moses took half the blood and put it in basins, and half the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
NKJV.7: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read in the hearing of the people. And they said, “All that the LORD has said we will do, and be obedient.”
NKJV.8: And Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant which the LORD has made with you according to all these words.”
NKJV.9: Then Moses went up, also Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
NKJV.10: and they saw the God of Israel. And there was under His feet as it were a paved work of sapphire stone, and it was like the very heavens in its clarity.
NKJV.11: But on the nobles of the children of Israel He did not lay His hand. So they saw God, and they ate and drank.

NKJV.13: So Moses arose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.
NKJV.14: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we come back to you. Indeed, Aaron and Hur are with you. If any man has a difficulty, let him go to them.”
NKJV.15: Then Moses went up into the mountain, and a cloud covered the mountain.
NKJV.16: Now the glory of the LORD rested on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day He called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
NKJV.17: The sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
NKJV.18: So Moses went into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

NASB.1: Then He said to Moses, 'Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu and seventy of the elders of Israel, and you shall worship at a distance.
NASB.2: 'Moses alone, however, shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near, nor shall the people come up with him.'
NASB.3: Then Moses came and recounted to the people all the words of the LORD and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice and said, 'All the words which the LORD has spoken we will do!'
NASB.4: Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Then he arose early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
NASB.5: He sent young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
NASB.6: Moses took half of the blood and put [it] in basins, and the [other] half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
NASB.7: Then he took the book of the covenant and read [it] in the hearing of the people; and they said, 'All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient!'
NASB.8: So Moses took the blood and sprinkled [it] on the people, and said, 'Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.'
NASB.9: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
NASB.10: and they saw the God of Israel; and under His feet there appeared to be a pavement of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
NASB.11: Yet He did not stretch out His hand against the nobles of the sons of Israel; and they saw God, and they ate and drank.
NASB.12: Now the LORD said to Moses, 'Come up to Me on the mountain and remain there, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commandment which I have written for their instruction.'
NASB.13: So Moses arose with Joshua his servant, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.
NASB.14: But to the elders he said, 'Wait here for us until we return to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you; whoever has a legal matter, let him approach them.'
NASB.15: Then Moses went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
NASB.16: The glory of the LORD rested on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days; and on the seventh day He called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.
NASB.17: And to the eyes of the sons of Israel the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountain top.
NASB.18: Moses entered the midst of the cloud as he went up to the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

NLT.1: Then the LORD instructed Moses: “Come up here to me, and bring along Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders. All of you must worship from a distance.
NLT.2: Only Moses is allowed to come near to the LORD. The others must not come near, and none of the other people are allowed to climb up the mountain with him.”
NLT.3: Then Moses went down to the people and repeated all the instructions and regulations the LORD had given him. All the people answered with one voice, “We will do everything the LORD has commanded.”
NLT.4: Then Moses carefully wrote down all the LORD’s instructions. Early the next morning Moses got up and built an altar at the foot of the mountain. He also set up twelve pillars, one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
NLT.5: Then he sent some of the young Israelite men to present burnt offerings and to sacrifice bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
NLT.6: Moses drained half the blood from these animals into basins. The other half he splattered against the altar.
NLT.7: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud to the people. Again they all responded, “We will do everything the LORD has commanded. We will obey.”
NLT.8: Then Moses took the blood from the basins and splattered it over the people, declaring, “Look, this blood confirms the covenant the LORD has made with you in giving you these instructions.”
NLT.9: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel climbed up the mountain.
NLT.10: There they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there seemed to be a surface of brilliant blue lapis lazuli, as clear as the sky itself.
NLT.11: And though these nobles of Israel gazed upon God, he did not destroy them. In fact, they ate a covenant meal, eating and drinking in his presence!
NLT.12: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain. Stay there, and I will give you the tablets of stone on which I have inscribed the instructions and commands so you can teach the people.”
NLT.13: So Moses and his assistant Joshua set out, and Moses climbed up the mountain of God.
NLT.14: Moses told the elders, “Stay here and wait for us until we come back. Aaron and Hur are here with you. If anyone has a dispute while I am gone, consult with them.”
NLT.15: Then Moses climbed up the mountain, and the cloud covered it.
NLT.16: And the glory of the LORD settled down on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from inside the cloud.
NLT.17: To the Israelites at the foot of the mountain, the glory of the LORD appeared at the summit like a consuming fire.
NLT.18: Then Moses disappeared into the cloud as he climbed higher up the mountain. He remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

WEB.1: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
WEB.2: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
WEB.3: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”
WEB.4: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
WEB.5: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.
WEB.6: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
WEB.7: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “All that Yahweh has spoken will we do, and be obedient.”
WEB.8: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”
WEB.9: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
WEB.10: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire  stone, like the skies for clearness.
WEB.11: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
WEB.12: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
WEB.13: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
WEB.14: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
WEB.15: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
WEB.16: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
WEB.17: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
WEB.18: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

AMP.1: Then God said to Moses, "Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu (Aaron's older sons), and seventy of Israel's elders, and you shall worship at a [safe] distance.
AMP.2: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others shall not come near, nor shall the people come up with him."
AMP.3: Then Moses came and told the people everything that the LORD had said and all the ordinances. And all the people answered with one voice, "Everything the LORD has said we will do."
AMP.4: Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Then he got up early in the morning, and built an altar [for worship] at the foot of the mountain with twelve pillars (memorial stones) representing the twelve tribes of Israel.
AMP.5: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
AMP.6: Moses took half of the blood and put it in large basins, and [the other] half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
AMP.7: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud to the people; and they said, "Everything that the LORD has said we will do, and we will be obedient."
AMP.8: So Moses took the blood [which had been placed in the large basins] and sprinkled it on the people, and said, "Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words."
AMP.9: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up [the mountainside],
AMP.10: and they saw [a manifestation of] the God of Israel; and under His feet there appeared to be a pavement of sapphire, just as clear as the sky itself.
AMP.11: Yet He did not stretch out His hand against the nobles of the Israelites; and they saw [the manifestation of the presence of] God, and ate and drank.
AMP.12: Now the LORD said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and stay there, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commandments which I have written for their instruction."
AMP.13: So Moses arose with Joshua his attendant, and he went up to the mountain of God.
AMP.14: And he said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Remember that Aaron and Hur are with you; whoever has a legal matter, let him go to them."
AMP.15: Then Moses went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
AMP.16: The glory and brilliance of the LORD rested on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day God called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.
AMP.17: In the sight of the Israelites the appearance of the glory and brilliance of the LORD was like consuming fire on the top of the mountain.
AMP.18: Moses entered the midst of the cloud and went up the mountain; and he was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

NET.7: He took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud to the people, and they said, “We are willing to do and obey all that the LORD has spoken.”
NET.8: So Moses took the blood and splashed it on the people and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
NET.9: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up,
NET.10: and they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear like the sky itself.
NET.11: But he did not lay a hand on the leaders of the Israelites, so they saw God, and they ate and they drank.
NET.12: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me to the mountain and remain there, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commandments that I have written, so that you may teach them.”
NET.13: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant, and Moses went up the mountain of God.
NET.14: He told the elders, “Wait for us in this place until we return to you. Here are Aaron and Hur with you. Whoever has any matters of dispute can approach them.”
NET.15: Moses went up the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
NET.16: The glory of the LORD resided on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day he called to Moses from within the cloud.
NET.17: Now the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in plain view of the people.
NET.18: Moses went into the cloud when he went up the mountain, and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

MSG.1: He said to Moses, "Climb the mountain to God, you and Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. They will worship from a distance;
MSG.2: only Moses will approach God. The rest are not to come close. And the people are not to climb the mountain at all."
MSG.3: So Moses went to the people and told them everything God had said—all the rules and regulations. They all answered in unison: "Everything God said, we'll do."
MSG.4: Then Moses wrote it all down, everything God had said. He got up early the next morning and built an Altar at the foot of the mountain using twelve pillar-stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
MSG.5: Then he directed young Israelite men to offer Whole-Burnt-Offerings and sacrifice Peace-Offerings of bulls.
MSG.6: Moses took half the blood and put it in bowls; the other half he threw against the Altar.
MSG.7: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it as the people listened. They said, "Everything God said, we'll do. Yes, we'll obey."
MSG.8: Moses took the rest of the blood and threw it out over the people, saying, "This is the blood of the covenant which God has made with you out of all these words I have spoken."
MSG.9: Then they climbed the mountain—Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel—
MSG.10: and saw the God of Israel. He was standing on a pavement of something like sapphires—pure, clear sky-blue.
MSG.11: He didn't hurt these pillar-leaders of the Israelites: They saw God; and they ate and drank.
MSG.12: God said to Moses, "Climb higher up the mountain and wait there for me; I'll give you tablets of stone, the teachings and commandments that I've written to instruct them."
MSG.13: So Moses got up, accompanied by Joshua his aide. And Moses climbed up the mountain of God.
MSG.14: He told the elders of Israel, "Wait for us here until we return to you. You have Aaron and Hur with you; if there are any problems, go to them."
MSG.15: Then Moses climbed the mountain. The Cloud covered the mountain.
MSG.16: The Glory of God settled over Mount Sinai. The Cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day he called out of the Cloud to Moses.
MSG.17: In the view of the Israelites below, the Glory of God looked like a raging fire at the top of the mountain.
MSG.18: Moses entered the middle of the Cloud and climbed the mountain. Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
